calculation.description: Cross-sectional reversal of each asset's 20-day momentum residual after removing its trailing 60-day SPX beta exposure, risk-normalized by trailing annualized volatility. All inputs are lagged/causal at the decision date.

metrics.icir_definition: mean daily cross-sectional Spearman IC / standard deviation of daily IC

validation.regime_notes: Available history produced no valid observations before 2025 due to source coverage. 2025-2027 IC 0.07212 (daily ICIR 0.1717); 2028-2029 IC 0.01029 (daily ICIR 0.0341); 2030 YTD IC 0.06873 (daily ICIR 0.2243). Positive recent reversal signal, but limited 15-asset cross-section warrants conservative interpretation.
